critique: The note proves rate equivalence only up to unspecified constants for absolute risk and honest expected length; the exact minimax constant and proposed exact-modulus interval remain open in oeq:sharp-constant. The result is confined to a one-time clamp, fixed finite strata, bounded outcomes, known smoothness and thinning parameters, and a global two-sided polynomial density envelope, so it does not settle longitudinal LMTP inference or flexible-covariate threshold policies. The causal theorem is an exact transport over the note's constructed full-data class, whose latent randomization and fiberwise structural-mean continuity are membership conditions, rather than a frontier over a broader published LMTP class. The TL;DR's matched-frontier and sharp-rate language is supported as an order claim by explicit same-class upper and lower bounds, and it does not present the open sharp constant as established.
